snippet.title: Boneraiser Minions - Trailer
snippet.description:
Boneraiser Minions is a gothic-horror auto-battler roguelite, where you must use the bones and souls of slain heroes to raise and upgrade your undead  legion.

Find out more and purchase here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1944570/Boneraiser_Minions/

Thanks to Eric Skiff for trailer music: https://ericskiff.com/
